purpose: Collect a single line of text with field labeling, helper content, validation feedback, and optional inline accessories.

notes: Use VeliProvider to localize tooltip labels and apply Dhivehi direction and typography.

useWhen: A form needs a single-line text, email, URL, telephone, search, or similar native input.
The field needs a visible label, helper text, validation message, or leading and trailing content.

avoidWhen.situation: The user must enter multiple lines of text.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use the multiline field with its resize and character-count behavior.

avoidWhen.situation: The field is specifically for credentials or search.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use the purpose-built component for built-in visibility or clear behavior.

supportedInteractions: Keyboard text entry and native input behaviors
Focus by clicking the field shell
Tooltip and header action interaction when supplied
approvedPatterns: Provide a visible label for form fields.
Show description text normally and errorMessage when invalid.
Use accessory slots for concise icons or supporting actions.
limitations: Direct child composition and style overrides are not supported.
className is intended for outer layout, not internal field styling.
accessibility: Uses React Aria TextField, Label, and Input semantics.
Required, disabled, read-only, and invalid states are exposed through React Aria.
responsive: The root and field shell fill their container; constrain width in the surrounding layout.
rtl: Field layout follows the active direction.
Email, URL, telephone, and password values remain LTR in RTL layouts.
